reuse.why: Uses db.first in the shared linkProviderAccount path, though it does not reuse db.getAccount or the accRow lookup the same function already performs a few lines later.

duplication.why: The account is now read twice in linkProviderAccount (closed check, then the existing SELECT * for upgradingId), a small redundant query rather than duplicated logic.

placement.why: The guard sits in linkProviderAccount, the single path every provider link function routes through, next to the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard.

scope.why: Focused, apart from an unrelated reordering of an import specifier.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow; extracting it as an assert helper alongside assertBankAccountNotLinked, or merging with the later account lookup, would be slightly tidier.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts linkProviderAccount, used by all provider link functions (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, Akahu, Fintegra, EnableBanking)
